findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.trychannel3.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_products · Public sink: search_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_products · Public sink: search_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
